prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='FT_rf', seasonality_champion='ONLY_DWT_rf', recommended_method='median_or_trimmed_mean'. Narrative: FT_rf achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) while ONLY_DWT_rf leads in seasonality capture (0.495), showing different models excel at different components. DWT_rf wins overall RMSE (250.85) with balanced performance across horizons. However, rankings are highly unstable (Kendall τ=-0.04) with concept drift detected, making robust median/trimmed_mean combinations preferable over weighted stacking to avoid overfitting noise.
